children.content:
version: '3.8'

services:
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    command: ["redis-server", "--appendonly", "yes", "--maxmemory", "256mb", "--maxmemory-policy", "allkeys-lru"]
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  redis_data:

# ⚡ Complete Redis In-Memory Architecture & Caching Track

Welcome to your full Redis learning workspace materialized with **Trak**.

## 📚 Comprehensive Module Index

| Module | Title | Key Topics Covered |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-and-server-architecture` | **Setup & Event Loop** | Single-threaded reactor event loop (epoll/kqueue), in-memory speed, `redis-cli` |
| `01-strings-and-binary-safety` | **Strings & Integers** | `SET`, `GET`, `INCR`, `DECR`, `MGET`/`MSET`, binary safety, atomic counters |
| `02-key-expiration-and-ttl` | **Expiration & Eviction** | `EXPIRE`, `TTL`, eviction policies (`allkeys-lru`, `volatile-lru`, `allkeys-lfu`) |
| `03-lists-and-message-queues` | **Lists & Queues** | `LPUSH`, `RPUSH`, `LPOP`, `RPOP`, `BLPOP` blocking queues, reliable queues |
| `04-sets-and-mathematical-operations` | **Sets & Tagging** | `SADD`, `SMEMBERS`, `SISMEMBER`, `SINTER` intersections, tag indexing |
| `05-hashes-and-object-storage` | **Hashes & Objects** | `HSET`, `HGET`, `HGETALL`, `HINCRBY`, memory-efficient listpack encoding |
| `06-sorted-sets-and-skiplists` | **Sorted Sets & SkipLists** | `ZADD`, `ZRANGE`, `ZRANK`, SkipList internals, leaderboards, rate limiters |
| `07-bitmaps-and-hyperloglogs` | **Bitmaps & HyperLogLog** | Bitmaps (`SETBIT`/`BITCOUNT` for DAU), HyperLogLog (`PFADD`/`PFCOUNT` cardinality) |
| `08-geospatial-indexes` | **Geospatial Indexes** | `GEOADD`, `GEODIST`, `GEOSEARCH`, proximity queries via Geohash |
| `09-streams-and-consumer-groups` | **Streams & Consumer Groups** | `XADD`, `XREAD`, Consumer Groups (`XGROUP`, `XREADGROUP`), `XACK`, pending entries |
| `10-pubsub-and-event-streaming` | **Pub/Sub Messaging** | `PUBLISH`, `SUBSCRIBE`, `PSUBSCRIBE` pattern matching vs Streams |
| `11-transactions-and-optimistic-locking` | **Transactions & WATCH** | `MULTI`, `EXEC`, `DISCARD`, optimistic concurrency control with `WATCH` |
| `12-lua-scripting-and-functions` | **Lua Scripting** | Atomic server-side `EVAL`, Redis Functions (`FUNCTION LOAD`), atomic rate limiters |
| `13-persistence-rdb-vs-aof` | **RDB & AOF Persistence** | RDB snapshotting (`fork()` CoW) vs AOF logging (`fsync: everysec`), hybrid persistence |
| `14-replication-and-sentinel-ha` | **Replication & Sentinel** | Primary-Replica async replication, Redis Sentinel auto-failover and quorum |
| `15-redis-cluster-and-sharding` | **Cluster & Hash Slots** | 16,384 hash slots, CRC16 hashing, hash tags (`{user:123}`), `MOVED`/`ASK` redirects |
| `16-caching-patterns-and-anti-patterns` | **Caching Architecture** | Cache-Aside, Write-Through, Cache Stampede, Cache Penetration, Bloom Filters |
| `17-security-acl-and-tls` | **Security & ACL** | Redis ACL (`ACL SETUSER`), command whitelisting, password auth, TLS |
| `18-interview-questions-and-drills` | **Interview Master Drill** | Top 10 Redis interview questions, distributed locking (Redlock), memory traps |

---

## 🛠️ Quick Commands

```bash
docker compose up -d
```

children.content:
# 00 - Redis Architecture & Event Loop 🛠️

### Why Redis is Ultra Fast:
1. **In-Memory Storage**: All primary data structures reside in RAM (sub-millisecond latency).
2. **Non-Blocking I/O Multiplexing**: Single-threaded event loop (`epoll` on Linux, `kqueue` on macOS) handles 100,000+ operations/sec without context-switching or lock contention overhead.
3. **C-Optimized Data Structures**: Custom SDS (Simple Dynamic Strings), SkipLists, and Dicts.

# 02 - Key Expiration & Eviction Policies

### Memory Eviction Policies (`maxmemory-policy`):
- `allkeys-lru`: Evicts least recently used keys out of all keys.
- `volatile-lru`: Evicts LRU keys among those with an expiration set.
- `allkeys-lfu`: Evicts least frequently used keys.
- `noeviction`: Returns out-of-memory error when RAM is full (Default).

children.name: rate_limiter.lua
children.content:
-- Atomic Sliding Window Rate Limiter in Lua
local key = KEYS[1]
local limit = tonumber(ARGV[1])
local current = redis.call('INCR', key)

if current == 1 then
    redis.call('EXPIRE', key, 60)
end

if current > limit then
    return 0 -- Rejected
else
    return 1 -- Allowed
end

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 13 - Persistence: RDB vs AOF

| Feature | RDB (Snapshot) | AOF (Append-Only File) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Mechanism** | Point-in-time binary snapshot (`fork()`) | Logs every write operation (`appendonly.aof`) |
| **Data Safety** | Potential data loss between snapshot intervals | Near zero data loss (`fsync: everysec`) |
| **Recovery Speed** | **Extremely Fast** (Direct binary load) | Slower (Replays command history) |
| **File Size** | Compact binary | Larger (requires periodic background rewrite `BGREWRITEAOF`) |

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 14 - Primary-Replica & Redis Sentinel

- **Replication**: Asynchronous streaming replication from Primary to Read-Replicas.
- **Sentinel**: Monitoring daemon quorum providing automated master failure detection, promotion, and client reconfiguration.

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 15 - Redis Cluster & 16,384 Hash Slots

- Redis Cluster distributes keys across **16,384 logical hash slots** calculated via `CRC16(key) % 16384`.
- **Hash Tags**: Use `{user:101}.profile` and `{user:101}.orders` to force multiple keys to hash to the exact same cluster node.

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 16 - Caching Patterns & Failure Modes

1. **Cache-Aside (Lazy Loading)**: App checks cache -> on miss queries DB -> writes back to cache.
2. **Cache Stampede (Thundering Herd)**: Key expires under heavy load -> thousands of concurrent requests hammer DB. Fix: Distributed lock (`Redlock`) or probabilistic early expiration (XFetch).
3. **Cache Penetration**: Querying keys that exist neither in cache nor in DB. Fix: Cache null values or use **Bloom Filters**.

# 18 - High-Yield Redis Interview Questions 🎯

### Top 5 Interview Questions:
1. **Single-Threaded Speed**: Memory access, non-blocking I/O multiplexing, zero locking overhead.
2. **RDB vs AOF**: Snapshotting speed vs write-log durability.
3. **Sorted Set Implementation**: Dual structure containing SkipList + HashTable.
4. **Distributed Locking (Redlock)**: Using `SET key val NX PX 30000` with unique random tokens.
5. **Cluster Sharding**: 16,384 hash slots with CRC16 hashing and hash tags.
